assumptions: The file is PSI mzML as pyteomics reads it.
limits: Reads the run; it does not centroid, filter or recalibrate it.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: A reader: the spectra as the mzML file writes them, with nothing inferred; the Mass spec panel's readings are on the tools that score them.
bio.jane/contract.question: What spectra, precursors and acquisition metadata does this mzML run hold?

description: Read the spectra of a PSI mzML run file: each spectrum's native id, MS level, centroid or profile, scan start time and unit, base peak, total ion current, precursor (selected ion m/z, charge, intensity, isolation window) and peak arrays, interpreted as pyteomics reads mzML (validated on every spectrum of three real runs). An MS/MS spectrum it returns is what score_spectrum takes as mz, intensity and precursorCharge.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

id.description: return only the spectrum with this native id; empty returns every spectrum.

msLevel.description: return only spectra at this MS level (0 returns every level).

name: read_mzml

spectra.description: one row per spectrum: id, msLevel, scanStartTime, precursors, mz, intensity
